marito.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic big old man in his seventies, heavy and broad: a big bald head with a fringe of grey hair at the sides, large ears, heavy bushy brows over small tired eyes, a big bulbous nose, a thick white walrus moustache and a heavy jaw; in a white vest, wrapped in a green and brown patterned wool blanket

parti.occhi_grave: His small eyes are sunken and glassy with very high fever, the whites red; sweat runs from his bald head; the skin around the eyes grey.

collo_grave.inquadratura: the side of the neck, from under the jaw to the collarbone
collo_grave.segni: Under the jaw, a large, hard, dark purple swelling the size of an egg, tight and shiny, with a darker spot in the middle: a plague bubo; the wrinkled skin around it hot and shiny with sweat.

mani_grave.inquadratura: both hands resting on his knees, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani_grave.segni: Big, heavy hands with broad spatula fingertips and bluish nail beds; now the tips of three fingers are turning black, as if burnt, dry and hard.

moglie.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic woman in her fifties, short, broad and sturdy: a big round head, a severe jet-black bob, a heavy frowning brow with thick dark eyebrows, small dark suspicious eyes, a big bulbous nose, a small downturned mouth; in a dark green knitted cardigan

parti.occhi_febbre: Small, dark, suspicious eyes under the heavy frowning brow, now glassy and red-rimmed with fever; beads of sweat on the forehead under the black fringe; the cheeks flushed.
